autoLockDescription: Locks after 15 minutes idle. Refreshing the page keeps the vault unlocked.
collectionSubtitle: Your saved logins, ready when you need them.
noResultsBody: Try a different name, website, or username.
emptyBody: Items will appear here after they are added to your vault.
loginDetailsSubtitle: Your account information for this service.

username.title: Username generator
username.hint: Made from common English words, ready to use as a username.

privateKeyNeverSaved: The private key stays with your system authenticator and is never saved or synced here.
recoveryCodePreviewNote: Used status is kept only in this browser preview session's memory. Saved encrypted persistence requires real API integration and is not available here.
mnemonicRisk: A wallet’s recovery phrase can control the wallet. Storing it here increases risk if your vault is compromised.

generator.title: Generator
generator.twoClassesRequired: Keep at least two character types enabled. A single type always creates a weak password.
generator.exhausted: No safe password passed the checks after {{attempts}} attempts. Try a longer length, more character types, or try again later.
generator.verificationUnavailable: The password could not be verified right now. Nothing was generated; please try again later.
generator.verifiedHint: This password passed the local weak-password list and the breach check.

health.title: Report
health.localOnlyHint: Passwords are checked in browser memory; only a five-character SHA-1 prefix is sent to HIBP for breach matching.
health.privacyNote: Your full password and full SHA-1 hash are never sent. Results are not uploaded or logged.
health.emptyVault: There are no vault items to check.
health.loadingDetails: Loading encrypted item details into memory…
health.loadFailed: Some item details could not be loaded. No partial result was saved; please try again.
health.commonWeak: Matches the local common weak-password list.
health.reused: This password is used by more than one vault item.
health.leaked: Found in known data breaches. Change this password.
health.unavailable: The breach service could not be reached, so exposure status is unknown.
health.acceptableHint: Acceptable for now; consider using at least 20 characters next time.

clipboardClearFailed: We couldn't verify or clear the clipboard. Remove the copied password from your clipboard manually.
name: Name
saveFailed: Could not save the item. Please try again.
deleteFailed: Could not delete the item. Please try again.
conflictMessage: This item was changed on another device. Reload to see the latest version.

mcpConfirmations.title: Confirmation requests
mcpConfirmations.emptyBody: When an AI connector asks to read a vault item, the request appears here for you to approve or deny.
mcpConfirmations.approvedMessage: Approved. The connector can read this item once.
mcpConfirmations.deniedMessage: Denied. The connector will not get this item.
mcpConfirmations.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.
